categories: 本地 AI 编程辅助
name: Reflexor: Local AI Coding Assistant & Agent (Ollama, DeepSeek, LLM, RAG)
summary: 发布者称，Reflexor 提供本地代码行内补全和代码库问答，代理执行操作前会请求批准。可从 Open VSX 获取扩展，在发布者列出的编辑器（如 VS Code）中使用，并接入 Ollama 或 LM Studio 等本地模型后端。https://open-vsx.org/extension/reflexor-app/reflexor

Reflexor’s publisher says the extension provides local inline completions and codebase chat, with an agent that asks for approval before acting. Install it from Open VSX for a listed editor such as VS Code, and use a local model backend such as Ollama or LM Studio. https://open-vsx.org/extension/reflexor-app/reflexor
